note: Marina RV park on Chickamauga Lake at 797 Cottonport Ferry Rd west of Decatur, with a restaurant, store, fishing docks, boat ramp and gas dock; regular and waterfront sites by the night, week or month, plus tent sites. --Claude
summary: Cottonport Marina & RV Resort: operator Wix page (rates unchanged in Wayback 2025-12 and 2026-07 captures), photos, Google, gateways, Esri + 3DEP read. $50 regular 30 A night (passes the gate at the line), FHU 30/50 A, 55 RV sites, laundry/store/wifi. Lakefront kept on the cove-side lawn sites; the riprap row by the store is closer to a view. Cheap monthly rates; nightly share unmeasured.
flags: PRICE GATE: pass at the line - Regular 30 A $50 a night (cheapest RV night; regular 50 A and waterfront 30 A $55, waterfront 50 A $65). Not a Good Sam Park; no gateway within 40 km. Google 4.7 (314).

WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT (stored --Claude value): the operator sells 'Water Front' sites by the night ($55/$65). No site numbers are published, so the sites are named by place. Cove-side lawn sites on the west side of the campground (e.g. 35.48444,-84.87978 at 209.6 m; 35.48427,-84.87987 at 210.8 m) sit 1.6-2.8 m above the 208.0 m summer pool, ~25-35 m from the high-water edge over open grass with scattered trees; the operator's photo shows rigs on open lawn with the water a low rock lip below. The row of ~6-7 sites along the riprap north-west of the store (35.48480-35.48485,-84.87984 to -84.87960; pads 211.2-211.8 m) is only ~8-12 m from the water but ~3.2 m above summer pool, with the last ~2 m a steep riprap face - by the kayak test those read as a view, though the fishing dock and boat ramp are a few steps away. Replacement waterfront evidence: 'Operator sells Water Front sites by the night; Esri + 3DEP (2026-11-25): cove-side lawn sites 1.6-2.8 m above 208.0 m summer pool, ~25-35 m over open grass with scattered trees, operator photo shows lawn to a low rock lip; riprap row by the store ~3.2 m above pool (view-like); lakefront.'

LONG-STAY: monthly rates are posted ($475 regular, $575 waterfront 50 A) beside nightly and weekly; imagery shows a dense RV block on the south side, likely long-term. Nightly share not measurable (no site map or booking engine). Tests 2 (posted nightly rate) and 5 (no lots sold) pass; reviewer may want the share by phone.
FACILITIES: 'bathhouse' is listed but showers/flush toilets are not named, so neither is written.
